Messages.Author: alf
Messages.Body:
Does the cost reduction from an anarch Sebastien Goulet work when you use Piper on him to recruit an ally?

Sébastien Goulet Sabbat: Allies and retainers cost Sébastien 1 less blood or pool. Once each action, he can burn 1 blood to get +1 bleed.

Name: Piper[TR:R] Cardtype: Master Master. Requires a ready anarch. A ready unlocked anarch you control employs or recruits a retainer or ally from your hand (requirements and cost apply as normal). This is not an action and cannot be blocked. Lock that anarch. Artist: Andrew Trabbold

<INSERT CLEVER QUOTATION HERE>

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> alf wrote:
> Does the cost reduction from an anarch Sebastien Goulet work when you use Piper on him to recruit an ally?
>
It does. Contrary to Charisma, Sébastien's special works even when there's no action.
